news.description: The same list as `articles`, kept for callers that read the older key.

newest_published_at.description: ISO time of the newest article returned. Null when there are none.

newest_age_hours.description: Hours since the newest article. Null when there are none.

coverage_stale.description: True when the newest article is over 72 hours old, or there are none. The window spans a weekend so a Friday article still reads as current on Monday.
